jobs.title: Senior Data Analytics Implementation Specialist
jobs.description_text: Sobre a função: Estamos à procura de uma pessoa para a função de Especialista Sénior em Data Analytics Implementation (m/f/d) para assumir a liderança técnica de projetos de arquitetura e medição de dados digitais. Nesta função, serás uma das principais referências técnicas da área, guiando projetos complexos do início ao fim: desde a fundação técnica (Data Layer, GTM, Server-Side, RGPD) até à otimização do negócio, atribuição e medição omnicanal. O teu foco principal será o ecossistema GA4 (Web e Apps), enriquecendo a medição com fontes omnicanal e dados de negócio. Uma parte central do trabalho consiste em compreender o impacto da media nestes dados e gerar insights acionáveis para as equipas de media otimizarem a sua performance. É fundamental ter conhecimentos em atribuição digital e no cruzamento de dados de GA4 com modelos de MMM (Marketing Mix Modeling). Responsabilidades Principais: Estratégia & Plano de Medição: Definir e manter o Plano de Medição (Measurement Plan), matrizes de KPIs e a arquitetura de dados das nossas plataformas digitais (Web e App). Garantir a consistência e padronização da taxonomia de dados, parametrização de URLs (UTMs) e rastreio (tracking) entre canais de media e produto. Implementação & Gestão de Tags (Tag Management): Desenvolver, testar e homologar tags, pixels e eventos via Google Tag Manager (Web e Server-Side). Implementar e gerir integrações via API (ex.: Conversions API do Meta, Google Ads API, CDPs e MMPs). Análise de Dados, Atribuiç

jobs.description_text: Role OverviewAre you passionate about security, compliance, and supporting mission-critical work? We're looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Facilities Security Officer (FSO) to lead and maintain our government security clearance programs! In this role, you will serve as the primary administrator of the company's Facility Clearance (FCL) and personnel security clearance program, helping ensure our continued ability to perform classified work for Government customers. You will also play a critical role in managing compliance with Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) requirements, supporting facility clearance eligibility, government reporting obligations, and mitigation activities. You'll partner with employees, leadership, government representatives, and cross-functional teams to maintain compliance, support cleared personnel and strengthen our overall security posture. NOTE: Due to minor traveling required to the Facility location, Candidates must reside in OR around the greater Chantilly, Virginia area.

They will also assist in proactive market engagement and business development activities to identify and increase demand for our platform products leading to increased solution sales success. A second European language especially Spanish would be a distinct advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description_text: OverviewThe AppLogic Team builds core software for the Graykey platform, which Law Enforcement and Government Agencies use to extract data from mobile devices. The AppLogic UI is where examiners do that work. We're a small, senior, hands-on team, and this role leads frontend for it. You'll work alongside our UX Design Team, turn their work into an interface that's fast, reliable, and easy to build on, and set the structure and conventions the rest of the team follows. The UI is a mature, server-rendered application built with plain JavaScript and Jinja templates, with CI/CD and unit tests in place. Examiners use it every day, so the job is steady improvement in place: better structure, better performance, and better data, one change at a time. If you're looking to start fresh on a new framework, this probably isn't the right fit. NOTE: Candidate must reside in Canada.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Platform - Magnet One
jobs.description_text: Role Overview Magnet One is the connective layer across our product portfolio, and the platform team builds the foundations every other team depends on: how customer organizations are structured, how users prove who they are, how purchases turn into working access, and how our own teams support all of it. Our customers are getting larger and structurally more complex - bigger agencies, federated deployments, stricter identity and data residency requirements - and the foundational decisions ahead deserve dedicated ownership rather than being made a ticket at a time. That's the role: one person who owns this domain end to end and gives it a deliberate direction. This is a builder's role with an unusually direct line to customer pain. Our administrators are IT and operations staff at law enforcement agencies, government labs, and enterprises - people who work under strict security policies, have limited tolerance for surprises, and often manage access for dozens or hundreds of investigators. Getting their experience right is a competitive advantage. Getting it wrong shows up as support tickets, stalled deployments, and renewals at risk.

You are the primary point of accountability for whether our core systems serve the way Pivot operates, not just whether tickets get closed. This role would be expected to travel regularly to build and maintain those relationships. The VP will partner with the VP of Project Finance, VP of Corporate Finance, and the CFO on broader financing strategy. jobs.title: Integration Embedded Engineer
jobs.description_text: You'd join Embedded Platform, the team inside Samba's TV engineering org that turns Samba's ACR technology - audio, video, and TV signal capture - into something that actually runs on hardware. That means writing to spec, working directly with OEM and SOC engineering teams, and validating what partners ship back before Samba can use any of it. This is about as upstream as it gets: if the signal doesn't get captured off the device, there's no TV data downstream, and TV data is the base layer Samba's whole business is built on. Beyond the core ACR work, the team also powers mobile apps that use TV viewership data and an edge AI feature that recognizes video game titles and shoppable items showing up on screen. Q4 brings a new OEM project live - Sony's audio ACR work and the Titan OS integration are both active right now. Whether that runs in parallel with everything else already on the team's plate, or reshuffles who's working on what, depends on who's in this seat.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Platform Security
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. We are looking for a Backend Engineer II to join our Security Compliance Engineering team. You’ll help turn complex security, risk, and compliance requirements into scalable software solutions that make it easier for teams across Spotify to build and operate securely. You’ll work with engineers and partners across security to strengthen our technical Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) capabilities.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer II - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

jobs.title: C++ Engineer - Experience

Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early! Atlas Network’s Training team is looking for an individual who is eager to learn more about training non profit organizations, working with think tanks around the world, and wants to develop their skills in a professional environment. The Training intern will support the team for both our in-person and online workshops. Atlas Network is a nonprofit that supports free market organizations (think tanks) and individuals across the globe with the potential to champion our vision of a free, prosperous, and peaceful society. Duties include, but are not limited to: Providing support for online course development and maintenance Providing logistical support for regional trainings Conducting data analysis from program feedback using SurveyMonkey, Doceb

jobs.title: LIBRE Regional Field Manager, Pennsylvania - Harrisburg
jobs.description_text: Rooted in the Hispanic community, The LIBRE Initiative brings people together to advance public policy solutions that create the freedom and opportunity that people need to chase their American Dream. LIBRE empowers our communities by fixing our broken immigration system, encouraging affordable and flexible healthcare options, building an individualized education system, and promoting a robust economy that helps everyone succeed. The LIBRE Initiative is a part of Americans for Prosperity and the Stand Together philanthropic community. As a Regional Field Manager (internally referred to as a Grassroots Engagement Director) you will identify, recruit, and engage grassroots leaders in the Harrisburg Tri-County area and mobilize them to take action, and drive policy reforms that open opportunities for all. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $50,000–$65,000 per year.

jobs.description_text: As Partner Experience Director, you will lead the strategy, standards, and team responsible for creating exceptional, highly personalized experiences for Stand Together's philanthropic and business partners. You will serve as the capability builder, that connects personal-layer between Stand Together and the leaders who partner with us, building trust not only with those partners but also with the professional teams around them, including Chiefs of Staff, Executive Assistants, and security leads. You will lead the transformation of Partner Relations into Partner Experience, elevating how we design agendas, seating and room composition, briefings, principal preparation, partner follow-up, recruitment, and retention. Working across Partnerships, Events, Guest Experience, and executive stakeholders, you will establish clear standards, scalable systems, and consistent practices that strengthen relationships before, during, and long after key engagements. Success in this role requires exceptional judgment, discretion, emotional intelligence, and the ability to anticipate needs in complex, high-stakes environments. Partner Experience plays a critical role in building the community at the center of Stand Together's development strategy. jobs.title: Priority Initiative Leader, Strong & Safe Communities
jobs.description_text: As the Priority Initiative Leader for our Strong & Safe Communities portfolio, you will serve as the key strategic leader accountable for developing and refining the strategy and theory of change for how Stand Together and its network of partners shift the national paradigm on Strong and Safe Communities—from one that treats people as problems to be managed, to one that empowers citizens and communities as problem solvers. This role sits at the intersection of movement strategy, coalition leadership, and organizational influence. You will bring together a complex and diverse set of stakeholders—including Stand Together organizations, philanthropic partners, nonprofits, donor partners, policy advocates, and community leaders—around an ambitious, comprehensive strategy designed to move the needle on a national scale. You will integrate the full breadth of Stand Together’s capabilities, from activations and storytelling to fundraising and partner development, to ensure our efforts are coordinated, compounding, and driving paradigm-level change. The ideal candidate brings experience from a sizable and complex philanthropic or corporate environment and has a track record of shaping and executing strategies that cross organizational boundaries and produce measurable, durable impact. Done well, this role will accelerate a fundamental shift in how Americans think about, talk about, and tackle the challenges facing their communities. jobs.description_text: As the Priority Initiative Leader for Uniting Americans Around Our Founding Principles (UAFP), you will serve as the key strategic leader accountable for developing and refining the strategy and theory of change for how Stand Together and its network of partners build a shared American identity grounded in the country’s founding principles, replacing a narrative of division with one of shared purpose and bottom-up contribution. This role sits at the intersection of narrative and movement strategy, high-profile coalition leadership, and civics-market building. You'll bring together a distinctive set of stakeholders - professional sports leagues and franchises, musicians and entertainment partners, philanthropic partners across the ideological spectrum, civics education organizations, and community leaders - around a shared campaign to make founding-principles-based citizenship culturally resonant at national scale. You'll integrate the full breadth of Stand Together’s capabilities, from national brand campaigns and content production to fundraising and partner development, so the movement’s narrative, action, and civics pillars compound rather than run independently. We are looking for someone who operates as the chief executive of a portfolio: reading a fast-moving cultural landscape quickly, prioritizing the opportunities that will drive the most impact, making the trade-offs that follow, and building the leaders who'll implement the strategies. jobs.title: Senior Partnerships Manager
jobs.description_text: Empowered is a community of social entrepreneur teachers, bringing the experiential, individualized, self-discovery teaching methodology to life in their classrooms. Their work leads to transformative learning experiences for their students. At scale, the Empowered community is a cultural movement driving bottom-up change throughout the key institution of education. Empowered is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. Empowered is seeking a Senior Partnerships Manager to develop talent, advance strategy, and lead high-value relationships that strengthen our Partnerships capability and create value for educators, partners, and the organization. In this role, you will lead and develop a high-performing Partnerships team, drive execution of an established vision and strategy, and build the knowledge needed to evolve the capability over time. You will manage your own portfolio of partnerships and contribute to other partnership opportunities where your experience and perspective can add value. As a member of Education Operations leadership, you will contribute beyond Partnerships by bringing external knowledge, challenging assumptions, and helping translate organizational priorities into action. This role is based in Wichita, Kansas. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000–$100,000 per year.

jobs.title: Contact Center Operations Specialist (InnovateNJ)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Contact Center Operations Specialist with 5 years of experience in help desk operations, support team training, or platform administration while delivering excellent customer service. In this role, you'll oversee chat and contact center operations. This includes creating training materials, protocols, and documentation that help support teams work independently. You'll improve customer service quality by analyzing support data and coaching staff, and work with technical specialists to configure and optimize our Amazon Connect platform. Strong candidates are comfortable with platform configuration, automation, and data analysis and understand help desk work well enough to train others. This position reports to the Product Director and collaborates closely with teams in the Business Experience and Residential Experience Initiatives and directly with state agency partners.

jobs.title: Director of Product (InnovateNJ)
jobs.description_text: We are hiring a Director of Product to co-lead our product management team and advance the product management practice within the office. This role focuses on empowering product managers to lead their teams effectively, ensuring that our solutions deliver value to New Jersey residents and business owners. You will champion product management excellence, oversee project staffing, and mentor a diverse and talented team, while also contributing to project work. Working closely with directors in product design, engineering, and content design you will foster a culture of collaboration and innovation, driving user impact and continuous improvement in our work. We are seeking candidates with a minimum of 7 years of professional experience in product management, along with at least 2 years of experience in people management. The ideal candidate will be a seasoned product manager adept at guiding end-to-end development, product planning, and execution, contributing to both product practice development and broader leadership and management functions within the office. This role will report to the Chief Innovation Officer, co-lead the product team with the current director of product, and work closely with initiative leads and other team members across the office.
